position_end: Programme 111 Numérique at 0.62% of credits ordonnancé (2026-04-30), against 15.43% across all programmes
note: the first per-programme execution figures Benin has ever published show programme 111 Numérique at 0.62% of credits ordonnancé at 30 April 2026 against 15.43% across all programmes, and 1.32% on the domestically financed portion alone, the whole of the execution being domestic because the programme's 6.5bn FCFA external loan tranche had drawn nothing; the ministry's own pilotage programme ran at 20.12%, so this is programme-specific rather than ministry-wide

subject: finance.budget
name: Quarterly budget execution reports (RAPEX)
milestone: Latest instalment held covers to 31 March 2025
position_end: Published quarterly, with a citizen version; latest instalment held covers to 31 March 2025
note: the Direction générale du Budget publishes an execution report at each quarter-end under décret n° 2015-035 portant Code de transparence, with a simplified citizen version; the citizen version at 31 December 2024 reports by economic nature and by function only — 2,507,185.8m FCFA executed against 2,551,700m provided, a 98.3% realisation rate, of which investment 38.29%, transfers 21.35% and personnel 20.86% — and carries no per-programme breakdown, so it yields no executed figure for any digital programme; the report at 31 March 2025 is held as a page-image artefact whose OCR layer is too corrupt to quote
